messages:
Zoe (Mktg): Quick sync 1 we need a concise social play for tomorrow's webinar 'Serving Smarter'  X thread + LinkedIn + pinned replay post 24h later. Can we lock assets and schedule today? https://redwood.example/webinar/serving-smarter
Cal (Design): I can do hero + 18s clip + two carousel frames. Square + 16:9 OK. Need two headline variants and CTA overlay.
Mina (Content): Caption A: 'Serving Smarter: scalable inference patterns from the field. Free webinar  Register: https://redwood.example/webinar/serving-smarter'
Mina (Content): Caption B: 'Lower p99, lower cost: our serving playbook. Join the panel  Sign up: https://redwood.example/webinar/serving-smarter'
Rhea (Growth): Timing rec: X announce 11:00am PT, X thread 11:05am, LinkedIn 11:30am, reminder X 3:00pm PT. Thread should be 5 posts (hook, stat, tip, customer quote, CTA).
Julian (Analytics): Use utm_source=social&utm_medium=xlnk&utm_campaign=serving_smarter_2026&utm_content={variant}. Adding event webinar_signup with demo_flag property.
Ivan (Sales): For demo-intent leads route to SDRs: immediate Slack ping + SFDC create. I'll own routing doc.
Zoe (Mktg): Cal please include transparent CTA layer so we can test on/off. CTA text: 'Reserve your seat'. Button color #ff6a00.
Cal (Design): Uploaded drafts to Figma: https://figma.com/file/serveX/serving-smarter-assets. ETA final exports 2:30pm PT.
Rhea (Growth): Ops: Schedly, queue posts per timing above. Default caption A, use B for thread CTA variant, attach UTM.
Schedly: Campaign scheduled: job#90044. Announcement queued for 2701239600 (11:00am PT). Thread set for 2701239900. Posting account: @redwoodinc.
Mina (Content): Thread copy pasted into campaign doc with micro-variants.
Julian (Analytics): Published tracking mapping and replay_utm plan. Will add watch_recording event for pinned replay.
Ivan (Sales): Confirmed Slack alert + SFDC mapping. Daily digest at 5pm PT and immediate pings for demo_flag=true.
Zoe (Mktg): Also pin a LinkedIn follow-up 24h after with recording + 3 TL;DR bullets. Rhea, can you set retargeting pool?
Rhea (Growth): Yes. Follow-up job queued post-recording; retargeting pool created.
Cal (Design): Final exports uploaded to Figma exports. Sending PNG/MP4 here.
Zoe (Mktg): Locking plan unless objections. Thanks team  special nod to @Cal. We'll monitor and report tomorrow AM. :rocket:
